claim: Ile de Re bridge car (Class 1) toll is EUR 16 high season (15 Jun-15 Sep), EUR 8 medium season (2 Mar-14 Jun and 16 Sep-14 Nov), EUR 4 low season (15 Nov-1 Mar); motorcycles over 50cc EUR 3, under 50cc free.
quote: High season: €16 / Medium season: €8 / Low season: €4 ... High: du 15 juin au 15 septembre ... Medium: du 02 mars au 14 juin ... du 16 septembre au 14 novembre ... Low: du 15 novembre au 01 mars

claim: The Ile de Re bridge is 2.9265 km long, up to 42 m above sea level, and the toll is charged one way only (crossing to the island); the return is free, and non-motorized vehicles (bikes) cross free.
quote: 2.9265 km long with a maximum height of 42 meters above sea level ... The toll is charged one way only – when crossing from La Rochelle to the island. Return trips are free.

claim: Compagnie Inter-iles full Ile d'Aix + Fort Boyard + La Rochelle cruise costs (one-way) EUR 39.50 adult, EUR 34 student, EUR 26.50 child 4-17, EUR 6 under-4 and pets.
quote: Adults: €39.50 / Students: €34.00 / Children (4-17 years): €26.50 / Under 4 years: €6.00 / Pets: €6.00

claim: The Inter-iles Fort Boyard sea promenade from La Rochelle (Vieux Port) lasts roughly 2h-2h15, passing the La Rochelle towers and Minimes port through the Pertuis d'Antioche before approaching the fort.
quote: The cruise lasts approximately 2 hours to 2 hours 15 minutes ... the captain navigates through Pertuis d'Antioche, offering a magnificent panorama of islands including Aix, Ré, and Oléron before approaching Fort Boyard.

claim: The commented Fort Boyard tour with Compagnie Inter-iles departs La Rochelle's Vieux Port, runs daily 7 Feb-30 Nov 2026, lasts about 2 hours and is priced around EUR 29; reservations by phone 05 46 50 55 54.
quote: The tour operates from February 7th to November 30th, 2026, every day ... The price is 29 euros ... Reservations must be made by telephone with the Compagnie Interîles at 05 46 50 55 54.

claim: Regional bus Line 3/3E links La Rochelle to Saint-Martin-de-Re in about one hour, with single tickets EUR 2.50 and return EUR 4.50.
quote: daily buses (Line 3/3E) connecting La Rochelle to Saint-Martin-de-Ré. Single tickets cost €2.50 and return tickets €4.50. In one hour you'll arrive at Saint-Martin-de-Ré

claim: Ile de Re has around 138 km of cycle paths and a dedicated double cycle lane on the bridge; Saint-Martin-de-Re is fortified with UNESCO-listed Vauban defences and the Phare des Baleines is one of France's tallest lighthouses.
quote: With 138 kms of cycle paths and shared paths, the island of Ré is the ideal destination for safe cycling ... The bridge has a double lane reserved for cyclists, and passage is free for non-motorized vehicles.

claim: A maritime shuttle (Croisieres Interiles) links Ile de Re and La Rochelle in about an hour, carrying up to 30 bikes (reservation required), with bike crossing for around EUR 1 in summer.
quote: a shuttle service between Île de Ré and La Rochelle offers a crossing lasting around an hour. Their ship can accommodate up to 30 bikes ... the shuttle ferry allows you to cross with your bike from La Rochelle for only €1 during the summer season.

claim: Ile d'Oleron is reached by a free 2,862 m viaduct (23 m high, ~3 min crossing) from Bourcefranc-le-Chapus, open 24/7 and accessible to cyclists and pedestrians; the bridge turns 60 in 2026.
quote: The road bridge of Oléron Island is free, unlike that of the island of Ré. The bridge stretches over a length of 2,862 meters, 23 meters above the sea, and the crossing time is approximately 3 minutes ... inaugurated on June 21, 1966.

claim: Ile d'Oleron is about an hour to 1.5 hours' drive from La Rochelle and at 35 km long by 12 km wide is easily explored in a day.
quote: just over an hour's drive from La Rochelle ... at just 35km long and 12km wide, it really isn't that large. Its location halfway between Royan and La Rochelle makes it ideal for day trips
